description: Source code implementing indirection buffer initialization functions for 3D convolution, depthwise convolution, deconvolution, and max pooling in QNNPACK, a quantized neural network package. Contains functions that set up pointers to input data for efficient convolution operations.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_conv3d
methods.description: Initializes the indirection buffer for 3D convolution by setting pointers to input data for each kernel position, batch, and group.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_dwconv
methods.description: Initializes the indirection buffer for depthwise convolution, setting pointers based on stride, dilation, and padding parameters.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_deconv2d
methods.description: Initializes the indirection buffer for 2D deconvolution (transposed convolution) with pointer calculations based on output position and kernel parameters.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_maxpool2d
methods.description: Initializes the indirection buffer for 2D max pooling by storing pointers to input data within pooling regions.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_set_step_dimensions
methods.description: Sets the step dimensions (step_width, step_height, step_depth) for the indirection buffer based on kernel and stride parameters.
